title: DTRA: Dynamic Topology Ring Architecture for Replay-Free Continual Visuomotor Control via Hyperspherical Isolation and Shared Motor Bases
description: DTRA v3.1.0 preprints (23-page pure-ASCII arXiv manuscript and versioned preprint) and verified multi-seed results for Task-ID-free continual visuomotor control without raw-demonstration replay. Reports full N=3 LIBERO-100 (K=100) results across all four core arms (Frozen MLP, ER 5%, DTRA Rigid, DTRA Elastic; unified sample std ddof=1), matched-encoder external CL baselines (DER++, L2P, O-LoRA), zero-retrain n_eval=20 extended initial-state verification (12,000 rollouts), and 3-seed 8-task Meta-World causal regularization ablations. Full parameter accounting (73% basis-slot / 5.33% total parameter reduction), routing-feature asymmetry, and clean/OOD trade-offs are documented transparently.
